description: Binding append-only authority for reviewed parser artifacts retained for release compatibility and rollback. Repository test harnesses, source files, build outputs and digest strings are not approved artifacts by implication. A record exists only after exact artifact verification, multi-role review, retention evidence and replay evidence are present.
registrationGuards: input record and artifact are outside the repository working tree
artifact SHA-256 and byte length are recomputed from exact bytes
artifact format, target OS, target architecture and protocol version are explicit
artifact ID, adapter-version tuple and digest are unique
three required approval roles use distinct operational pseudonyms
build provenance, security review and independent retention evidence exist
at least one exact-source replay evidence reference exists
all evidence refs are tracked, repository-contained, symlink-free files whose current bytes equal HEAD
append-time SHA-256 digests bind every evidence ref per artifact and historical registry validation rejects later byte drift
every compatible release ID already exists in the approved release registry
rollback retention is RETAINED only when immutable retention evidence exists
record contains no credential, infrastructure URL or user content
registry update uses the canonical exclusive append lock and atomic replacement
registry is revalidated after append and restored byte-for-byte if post-append validation fails
forbiddenArtifactSources: Go test binary re-executed as a worker
CI PASS without artifact bytes and approvals
artifact digest copied from a Preview or fixture
mutable latest tag or branch head
